parameters.name: Enable
parameters.description: Enable the auto-restart feature for this EU.

parameters.name: RetryMinimumWaitInterval
parameters.description: Configures the initial delay in {{units}} between detecting that the EU has terminated abnormally and re-starting it.

parameters.name: RetryMaximumWaitInterval
parameters.description: Configures the maximum delay in {{units}} between detecting that the EU has terminated abnormally and re-starting it.

parameters.name: RetryIntervalMultiplier
parameters.description: Configures the retry interval multiplier. This value is expressed in units of 0.001, so for example a value of 2000 will result in the retry interval being doubled each time.

parameters.name: MaximumRetryCount
parameters.description: Configures the maximum number of consecutive restarts (as shown in {{param|RetryCount}}) after which no more attempts will be performed. A value of zero means that the number of attempts is unlimited.

parameters.name: ResetPeriod
parameters.description: If the EU runs for this number of {{units}} without terminating abnormally the Agent MAY reset the {{param|RetryCount}} to zero, thereby resetting the exponential backoff algorithm. A value of zero disables this behavior.

parameters.name: RetryCount
parameters.description: The number times the EU has terminated abnormally and a restart has been attempted. Resetting this parameter to zero has the effect of re-initialising the exponential back-off algorithm. Invoking the {{command|#.Restart()}} command also has the effect of resetting this parameter to zero.

parameters.name: LastRestarted
parameters.description: The time at which the {{object|#}} was last re-started. Initially this parameter is set to the Unknown Time (0001-01-01T00:00:00Z).

parameters.name: NextRestart
parameters.description: The time at which the next restart of the {{object|#}} is scheduled to occur. The Infinite Time (9999-12-31T23:59:59Z) is used to indicate that no restart is currently scheduled.

object.description: Configures the parameters of the auto-restart algorithm for this EU. An auto-restart may be triggered if the Agent determines that the EU has terminated abnormally. An exponential backoff algorithm is applied (increasing each time the delay before the EU is re-launched) in order to prevent continual re-starting of the EU. The retry interval range is controlled by two Parameters, {{param|RetryMinimumWaitInterval}} and {{param|RetryIntervalMultiplier}}. Let ''m'' be the value of {{param|RetryMinimumWaitInterval}}, ''k'' the value of {{param|RetryIntervalMultiplier}}, and ''n'' the current value of {{param|RetryCount}}. Then on the next occasion that the Agent determines that the EU has terminated abnormally, the delay before re-starting the EU must lie between ''m * (k/1000)^n^'' and ''m * (k/1000)^(n+1)^'' seconds, so long as ''m * (k/1000)^n^'' evaluates to a value less than {{param|RetryMaximumWaitInterval}}. Once this point has been reached, on all subsequent occasion that the Agent determines that the EU has terminated abnormally the delay before re-starting the EU must lie between {{param|RetryMaximumWaitInterval}}'' * (1000/k)'' and {{param|RetryMaximumWaitInterval}} seconds.
